references.text: Instructions for the holy incense that was to be used in the tabernacle, the same incense that filled the golden bowl
The golden bowls (kappot) made for use in the sanctuary, mentioned in connection with the table of showbread
The first time the golden bowl filled with incense is mentioned in the listing of the tribes' offerings, identical wording
A summarizing verse that sums up all twelve golden bowls filled with incense from the tribal leaders
Incense used in worship; Aaron took incense into the Most Holy Place on the Day of Atonement
Golden bowls full of incense in heaven, representing the prayers of the saints
An angel with a golden censer and incense at the altar; the incense rises before God together with the prayers of the saints
